name: Window Nativizer
description:
Rounds the corners of windows that draw their own frame (Qt, Electron, GTK3, Wine) to Adwaita's radius, bakes their shadows on the GPU, and widens their resize edges to GTK's width. Apps that already look native because they link libadwaita or libhandy are recognised from /proc/<pid>/maps and keep their own corners and shadow; no Shell, Meta or Gio API reports a client's toolkit.
No telemetry, no network access. Stored in GSettings: your correction rules, the window title each was picked from (shown in preferences, never matched on), and two display preferences. Rules export to and import from the clipboard on request. The window picker is a session-bus method: any local process can call it, and the click it waits for is the gate.
